# Code, names, and nouns with the grammar

The fuel pump unit is clean.

The Aerospace Security Defence Industries Association writes the standard.

Make each warning an error.

Stop the pump before its cleaning.

Do these steps to examine the files:

1. Run `ste lint --format json --summary docs/`. That command examines the rules.
2. Open the `ste report --format json` result.
3. Read the `summary.findings` value.

| Step | Action |
|---|---|
| 1 | Run `ste lint --format json --limit 20 .` now. |

> Run `ste lint --format json --fields rule_id,file .` first.
